eventsFunctionsExtensions.name: RealTimeMP
eventsFunctionsExtensions.shortDescription: Complete real-time multiplayer: rooms, player sync, custom events, RPC, chat, lobby — connect to any WebSocket server.
description: A complete, fully customizable real-time multiplayer extension. Connect to **any** WebSocket server — your own, a free service, or a local server.
- Room system: create, join, leave rooms with optional passwords
- Full **player state sync** (position, angle, custom data)
- **Custom events** (broadcast or targeted to one player)
- **Remote Procedure Calls (RPC)** — trigger actions on other clients
- **Host migration** — new host assigned automatically if host leaves
- **Object synchronization** — sync any game object position
- All data structures exposed as GDevelop variables
1. Import this extension into your GDevelop project
2. Deploy the included Node.js server (server code in the description below)
3. Use `Connect to server` action on scene start
- Deploy to Railway, Render, Fly.io, or Glitch (all free tiers)
// Minimal Node.js server (save as server.js, run: node server.js)
const wss = new WebSocket.Server({ port: process.env.PORT || 8080 });
const player = { id: playerId, name: '', room: null, ws };
let msg; try { msg = JSON.parse(raw); } catch { return; }

const room = { id: rid, name: msg.roomName || rid, host: playerId, players: new Set([playerId]), variables: {}, password: msg.password || '', maxPlayers: msg.maxPlayers || 8, isPrivate: msg.isPrivate || false };
ws.send(JSON.stringify({ type: 'room_joined', roomId: rid, isHost: true, players: playerData, variables: {} }));
if (!room) { ws.send(JSON.stringify({ type: 'error', message: 'Room not found' })); return; }
if (room.password && room.password !== msg.password) { ws.send(JSON.stringify({ type: 'error', message: 'Wrong password' })); return; }
if (room.players.size >= room.maxPlayers) { ws.send(JSON.stringify({ type: 'error', message: 'Room full' })); return; }
for (const pid of room.players) { const p2 = players.get(pid); if (p2) pData[pid] = { name: p2.name }; }
ws.send(JSON.stringify({ type: 'room_joined', roomId: msg.roomId, isHost: playerId === room.host, players: pData, variables: room.variables }));
broadcast(msg.roomId, { type: 'player_joined', playerId, playerName: player.name, playerData: { name: player.name } }, playerId);
if (player.room) broadcast(player.room, { type: 'player_state', playerId, state: msg.state }, playerId);
const evtMsg = { type: 'custom_event', name: msg.name, data: msg.data, senderId: playerId };
const rpcMsg = { type: 'rpc', name: msg.name, args: msg.args, senderId: playerId };
if (player.room) broadcast(player.room, { type: 'chat', senderId: playerId, senderName: player.name, text: msg.text }, null);
broadcast(player.room, { type: 'room_variable', key: msg.key, value: msg.value }, null);
if (player.room) broadcast(player.room, { type: 'object_sync', objects: msg.objects }, playerId);
if (!r.isPrivate) list.push({ id: rid, name: r.name, playerCount: r.players.size, maxPlayers: r.maxPlayers, locked: !!r.password });
